title: Say Baryo ed Gilig na Bista
intro: Naromog mo so inkasika ed sakey a baryo ed gilig na dayat, a ditan et say tanol na daluyon so manlalaok ed saray bulong na saray totoon alingwanan la. Sikaray naikdan na ganggan a manpainawa, balet say inkaagum da so angitonton ed dusa ya siansia nin sasalitaen ed mareen iran tono. Sarag mon naamtaan no siopa ra?
clues: Manaayam kami ed gilig na dayat tan niganggan kamin manpainawa.
Diad saman ya agew, onsasabi ed sikami so dakel a sira, balet sebel ed sikami so mangala ed saratan.
Arum ed sikami so amasakbay sumpad panagsumlang, balet arum so nankokomplot pian mansigay nin siansia.
Sinumpa mi so sagradon ganggan tan angiter kami na ambelat a dusa ed inkasikatayo.
Say dusa mi et sakey a pananguman ya angitilak ed sikami ya ag-inkayadyari tan abaingan.
Nagmaliw kamin ayep, sakey a tanda parad amin ya ontumbok.

arabic: وَسْـَٔلْهُمْ عَنِ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِى كَانَتْ حَاضِرَةَ ٱلْبَحْرِ إِذْ يَعْدُونَ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ إِذْ تَأْتِيهِمْ حِيتَانُهُمْ يَوْمَ سَبْتِهِمْ شُرَّعًۭا وَيَوْمَ لَا يَسْبِتُونَ ۙ لَا تَأْتِيهِمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَبْلُوهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ
verse: And ask them about the town that was by the sea - when they transgressed in [the matter of] the sabbath - when their fish came to them openly on their sabbath day, and the day they had no sabbath they did not come to them. Thus did We give them trial because they were defiantly disobedient. (7:163)
